title: SII Vol. 3 No. 119 — Tiruvisalur
location_detail: On The North Wall Of The Central Shrine In The Sivayoganathasvamin Temple At Tiruvisalur
summary: This inscription is dated in the 2nd year of Rajakesarivarman and registers a gift of land to the temple at Tiruvisalur by Pirantakan Irungolan alias Siriyavelar of Kodumbalur

title: SII Vol. 3 No. 120
summary: This is again a record of Rajakesarivarman dated in the 4th year and must be attributed to Parantaka II, since it mentions the General Pirantakan Irungolar alias Siriyavelar

title: SII Vol. 3 No. 121
summary: This Sanskrit inscription supplies some additional information about [Pirantakan] Irungolar alias Sririyavelar mentioned in the two previous records

title: SII Vol. 3 No. 122 — Tirukkalittattai
location_detail: On The South Wall Of The Central Shrine In The Vedapurisvara Temple At Tirukkalittattai
summary: This incomplete record, dated in the 14th year of Rajakesarivarman, registers gifts of money in ilakkasu made by Rajadichchi and Kunjiramalli, the wife and daughter respectively of Siriyavelan, for burning lamps in the temple at Tirukkudittittai which was included in Amaninarayana-chaturvedimangalam
